author: curriculum-architect
songSummary: Practices skip patterns, counting repeated notes, a pattern moved lower, verse and chorus, and two-hand teamwork, with a silly old singalong.

classes.title: Hop, hop: 1, 3, 5
classes.goal: Find the five-finger place on C and play the hopping C, E, G pattern.

mathTarget.parentLine: Hopping over one key each time

classes.parentPrompt: Help the thumb find C, left of the two black keys; touch the keys that get skipped.
classes.childAction: Five fingers on C to G, then hop: thumb, middle, pinky.
classes.bridge: C, E, G is hopscotch: land, hop over one, land, hop over one, land.

intro.caption: Hop over one key
intro.parentCue: touch the skipped keys so your child sees them

games.caption: Hop up and back: C, E, G

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: finding the hand's place and a skipping pattern.

classes.title: How many Ds?
classes.goal: Play 'sing Polly wolly doodle' and count the same-note run: six Ds in a row.

mathTarget.parentLine: Counting how many times the same key plays

classes.parentPrompt: Hold up one finger for each D your child plays; count aloud together to six.
classes.childAction: Play the Ds and count them out loud: one to six.
classes.bridge: Six quick Ds are six little doodle hops on one spot before moving on.

intro.caption: Count the doodle hops
intro.parentCue: hold up one finger for each D

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: counting repeated notes while playing.

classes.title: Fare thee well, step down
classes.goal: Play 'fare thee well' twice: the same shape, the second time one key lower.

mathTarget.parentLine: The same shape again, starting one key lower

classes.parentPrompt: Play the first 'fare thee well', then slide your child's hand one key left for the second.
classes.childAction: Play G, G, E, then the same shape lower: F, F, D.
classes.bridge: The second wave goodbye is the same wave, one step down the stairs.

intro.caption: Same wave, one step lower
intro.parentCue: wave goodbye on each 'fare thee well'

games.caption: Fare thee well, fare thee well

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: playing the same pattern one step lower.

classes.title: Story part, goodbye part
classes.goal: Play the whole song slowly and notice the verse and the 'fare thee well' chorus.

mathTarget.parentLine: A song can have a story part and a chorus part

classes.parentPrompt: Sway on the verse; wave on 'fare thee well'. Sing the next word if your child gets stuck.
classes.childAction: Play slowly and spot when the 'fare thee well' part starts.
classes.bridge: The verse is the silly trip; the chorus is waving goodbye at the door.

intro.caption: Story part, goodbye part
intro.parentCue: wave together when the chorus starts

games.caption: Tap the beat: the first line
games.parentCue: Play the blue keys; your child taps the beat

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: hearing the verse and chorus of a song.

classes.title: Low note, same name
classes.goal: Play one low left-hand note at the start of each bar while the grown-up plays the tune.

mathTarget.parentLine: The same note name lives lower on the left

classes.parentPrompt: Play the tune while your child plays the low notes. Count bars out loud: one, two, three.
classes.childAction: Play one low note with your left hand at each 'one'.
classes.bridge: The low note is the same name in a lower house, far to the left.

games.caption: Same name, lower house
games.parentCue: Point left on each low C

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: playing low notes with the left hand.

classes.title: One slow, eight quick
classes.goal: Play the quick tune with one low left-hand note per bar, very slowly.

mathTarget.parentLine: One low note while the right hand plays eight quick ones

classes.parentPrompt: Rest a hand on your child's left shoulder and say 'low' on each bar. Go very slowly.
classes.childAction: Left hand plays one low note; right hand runs eight quick notes.
classes.bridge: The left hand is a big slow drum; the right hand is quick running feet.

intro.caption: One slow, eight quick
intro.parentCue: say 'low' on each bar, very slowly

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: playing a slow part and a quick part together.

classes.title: Sing along all the day
classes.goal: Play the whole song along with the music at full speed.

mathTarget.parentLine: Keeping up with a beat that does not wait

classes.parentPrompt: Sit beside your child, sing the silly words and nod on every one; keep going past slips.
classes.childAction: Play along with the music and keep going, even after a slip.
classes.bridge: The music is a bouncy wagon ride; hold on and keep rolling past bumps.

intro.caption: Hop on and keep going
intro.parentCue: sing along and smile at slips

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: keeping up with the music together.

classes.title: Silly concert for teddy
classes.goal: Play the whole song for teddy with a bouncy, silly sound, then bow.

mathTarget.parentLine: Playing the same notes with a light, bouncy feel

classes.parentPrompt: Seat teddy as the audience; sing 'polly wolly doodle' in your silliest voice, then bow.
classes.childAction: Play light and bouncy for teddy, then take a big bow.
classes.bridge: Light fingers bounce like a ball; the chorus waves goodbye with a smile.
classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: playing a whole song with a bouncy feel.
